reviews.title: Updates have broken the app
reviews.text:
Up until 3-4 months ago, I would’ve confidently rated the app a 5/5 stars. I really enjoy using it and found it reliable. Unfortunately, recent updates have significantly affected the accuracy of my statistics. 

For example, if I listen to a song once for four minutes, the app now shows it as four separate one minute streams. Songs that previously had 100+ streams are displaying as zero, whilst tracks I’ve never listened to are appearing at the top of my Lifetime Top Songs page. This makes the app feel unreliable, which is disappointing for an app centred around detailed listening stats. 

I understand the team is likely very busy, but I haven’t had any success contacting support about these issues, 6 weeks since my first email. It’s just a shame that a product many of us have paid for isn’t currently working as advertised. 

I really hope these issues can be resolved soon, as I’d love to return to giving this app a higher rating.

reviews.title: Cool idea, too many ads
reviews.text:
This is genuinely a really cool idea and exactly the sort of app I’d normally be interested in using. The concept is strong and it looks great visually.

However, I struggle to see enough value to justify the premium subscription in its current form. Within the first minute of using it, I was prompted multiple times to upgrade, and I had to sit through two ads almost immediately. There were also ads placed throughout the stats screens, which made the experience feel quite cluttered.

I only spent about 45 seconds in the app before deciding to delete it, which is a shame because the core idea has real potential. If the value offering was clearer and the upselling less aggressive, I think more people would be willing to stick around and explore it properly.

It definitely has promise, but the balance between value and monetisation needs some work.
